title: Every run is now recorded
text: The game now records each playthrough on the phone as a video, with the game's sound and the player's microphone. Nothing has to be started by hand. The recordings are for finding faults, and they are moved off the phone afterwards.

title: Two encounters you can play
text: Two encounters now run on the phone, chosen from a start screen. In the first, two goblins guard a box, and you can fight, talk, sneak or trade to get it. In the second, the Silk Mother moves only while she is out of the picture.
